issues.detail: Vault speaker: shape and face tone
issues.problem: The fitting is a straight rounded rectangle with a uniformly grey face. In c120 the vault fitting is a gently curved (bowed) rounded slot, about 3.5:1, whose face is the same tone as the vault (186-193 on a 186-195 vault). It is drawn only by a thin shadow on one long edge and a highlight on the other. After the last tweak, the model face is 0.87 of the vault in v6 (141-147 on 165), but still about 0.67 in the older renders v8, v11, v2 and v7 (110 on 165), where it reads as a dark slot.
issues.evidence: r8v/v6 row 248: 147..140 against a 165 vault. r8v/v8 row 60: 108-118 against 165. Crops: raterB8/c120_crop.png against raterB8/v6_crop.png.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: set CEILMAT.bezelIn.c to the vault colour (#e6e4df; it is baked with the vault anyway), so the pocket reads only by its 3.6 mm depth and shadow. Give the fitting a bow: in vaultPanel, or as a post-pass on the three speaker meshes, offset z by +0.03*(1-(2u-1)^2) along the long side, so the centre sits aft of the ends as in c120. Re-render v8, v11, v2 and v7 to confirm.

issues.problem: Across the vault the tone runs in plateaus and ramps instead of a smooth falloff, so faint fore-aft streaks show along the vault. They are clearest in v2, v7 and v6.
issues.fix: The normals are smooth (gSweep) and the bake is per vertex, so the steps most likely come from the AO volume's trilinear grid or the shadow-map filter (a lighting/integration item: raise AO-volume resolution over y 2.2-2.6, or blur the AO lookup). On the ceiling side, raise VAULT N from 26 to 48 in 07b_ceiling.js so the bake and eFn have more samples; the cost is small.

issues.detail: Outboard PSU shingle risers at a grazing angle
issues.problem: In the J and F cabins, seen from the aisle at a low angle, every shingle riser reads as a 5-6 px mid-grey stripe (0.70 contrast), giving a venetian-blind look. In c26 the steps are soft, with 0.85-0.95 contrast.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js / 08_bins.js PSU band: lighten the riser colour toward the band (for example 0.92x the band instead of the current darker step colour), or give the riser a small emissive (e 0.05) so it does not fall into shadow at grazing angles. Keep the 5 mm height.

issues.problem: In the close-ups, the row-placard icons beside '35' draw as small empty boxes ('35 □□□□'). c120 shows readable seat/person pictograms ('17 [seat icons]').
issues.fix: 06_atlas.js is not a ceiling file. Ask the atlas owner to draw the seat-letter/person pictogram glyphs in the placard cell at 2x and size, or drop the icons to a single pictogram that survives the mips.
